subject.title: fix(acp): close shared state database on gateway shutdown (#100637)

question: Should maintainers treat this focused ACP shutdown close as the canonical fix for #100637, or wait for the broader process-global SQLite cache lifecycle PR #100827?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same SQLite handle leak at different lifecycle ownership layers, and this PR still needs proof refreshed after force-pushed current-head changes.

options.title: Use This Focused PR After Proof
options.body: Require redacted current-head ACP SIGINT/SIGTERM or hot-reload terminal/log proof, then review this branch as the narrow ACP-owned fix.

options.title: Prefer Broader Cache Lifecycle
options.body: Use #100827 if maintainers want shared SQLite cache owners to close themselves across entry points instead of closing from ACP shutdown.

options.title: Pause Until Canonical Lands
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge it until #100637 has one selected lifecycle boundary and sibling PRs can be closed or superseded cleanly.

recommendation.title: Use This Focused PR After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted current-head ACP SIGINT/SIGTERM or hot-reload terminal/log proof, then review this branch as the narrow ACP-owned fix.
